name: 60064 · North Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60064 (North Chicago) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60064 (North Chicago) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60064 (North Chicago) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
